run_optimization: run the hair strand optimization script with a given config file and data path
run_strands_opt: run the strands_opt function from CT2Hair optim module with a parsed HOCON config object
parse_hocon_config: parse a HOCON config file using pyhocon ConfigFactory and resolve DATAPATH and CASENAME placeholders
check_interpolated_strands: check if the interpolated hair strands merged bin file exists before running optimization
configure_optimization_paths: configure the point cloud path and interpolated strands path in the config object
